headline: THUNDERSTORMS OVER PARTS OF NIGERIA
area: Some states in Nigeria will be affected.
description: Severe thunderstorms accompanied with moderate rains and strong winds are expected to propagate westward affecting parts of Adamawa,Borno,Yobe,Taraba, Gombe, Bauchi,Jigawa, Kaduna,Katsina Kano, Plateau, the Federal Capital Territory, Nasarawa,Niger states,Benue,Zamfara,Kebbi,Enugu, Ebonyi,Anambra,Imo,Abia,Cross river,Bayelsa,Delta,Ondo,Edo,Lagos,Osun and Ekiti states.
instruction: Keep away from tall trees and unstable objects. Drivers should take precaution when driving under heavy rains. Disconnect electrical appliances from Electrical sockets.
